verdict.rationale: Buzz documents its own automation surfaces. These include YAML-as-code automation with traces, workflows that can be triggered and approved via the CLI, and an ACP harness that listens for @mentions and prompts agents. Remote agents are also designed to run headlessly on pluggable substrates such as Kubernetes, where they are steered only through the relay. missing for 10: detailed workflow docs (trigger types, schedules, YAML schema), evidence that automations run unattended on schedules or events beyond mentions, and independent hands-on corroboration.
